description: Compare two refs of an Origin-hosted repository relative to their merge base. Choose a single view: summary or files. view defaults to summary. Files pages the paths that differ between head and the merge base, including per-file patches. Continuation calls must resend base and head with pageToken; an omitted view still pages files.

name.description: Origin repository name within that namespace

owner.description: Origin namespace (owner) slug, taken from list_namespaces or an earlier Origin result. A GitHub owner or org name is not an Origin namespace unless list_namespaces returns it.
